refinement_history.v01: Best directional coverage/hit-rate balance on consumed 365-day diagnostic window.

refinement_history.v03: 50/50 hybrid restored coverage but did not improve v0.1 accuracy and worsened extremity miss rate.
refinement_history.v04: Returns canonical direction to exact v0.1 and moves MTF/risk/evidence into a Forex-style Actionability quality overlay.
